senses.en_definition: Past events and the record or account of them; history.
The study of past events, including history as a school subject.

messages.en: Is tomorrow's history quiz just on chapter three? I'm worried I've been studying the wrong chapter.
Chapters three and four. The teacher already told us in the group chat earlier.
Oh no, I haven't read chapter four yet. Let's revise together tonight.
You're here already? You came all this way even though it's so late. You're a true friend.
Of course. I'm just here to help you out. Which box should I carry first?
We only have to walk two kilometres to get to the station.
That's still quite a walk. Shall we just take the bus?

senses.en_definition: Cold or cool; having a low temperature.

collocations.en: be unable to stand the cold

senses.en_definition: Calm, reassured or relieved in mind or spirit.

messages.en: It's absolutely freezing in here. Have you got a spare jacket?
Yeah, in my drawer. Go ahead and borrow it.
Thanks! I'll give it back after the meeting.
